title: Motion for a further extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
July 16, 2025
Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543-0001
 Re: First Choice Women’s Resource Centers, Inc v. Platkin
  Case No. 24-781
Dear Mr. Harris:
Pursuant to Rule 30.4, the parties respectfully request an additional
extension of the briefing schedule in the above-captioned case. On June 24, 2025
this Court granted the parties a short extension of time to file the merits briefs.
Currently, Petitioner’s opening brief and the joint appendix, are due August 7, 2025
and Respondent’s brief is due September 15, 2025.
The parties request that the due dates for each of their briefs be extended an
additional 14 days as follows:
Opening Brief and Joint Appendix August 21, 2025
Response Brief    October 14, 2025
Reply Brief     November 14, 2025
This extension of time is requested to accommodate the professional
obligations of the parties’ counsel.
Respectfully Submitted,
s/Erin M. Hawley
Erin M. Hawley
Counsel for Petitioner

PROOF OF SERVICE

I, Erin M. Hawley, counsel for Petitioner and a member of the Bar of this Court,
certify that on this 16th day of July, 2025, I caused the Motion for Extension of Time
for Merits Briefing to be served by electronic means on the following:

  Jeremy M. Feigenbaum
  Solicitor General
  Office of the New Jersey Attorney General
  R.J. Hughes Justice Complex
  25 Market Street
  Trenton, NJ 08625
  jeremy.feigenbaum@njoag.gov

 I further certify that all parties required to be served have been served.


 Executed on July 16, 2025

       s/Erin M. Hawley
 ERIN M. HAWLEY
